parameters.content:
## 🌱 Post-Purchase Sequence
**Help → tip → "did it work?" → review or rescue.**

### Setup (about 12 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → `storeName`, `fromEmail`, `reviewUrl`, `usageTip`.
2. POST each completed order:
   ```json
   { "orderId": "...", "email": "...",
     "name": "...", "productName": "..." }
   ```
   *(Or chain it from A1-01 after delivery succeeds.)*
3. Attach SMTP. Activate. The schedule runs the sequence.

### Two problems, one sequence
No reviews and no repeat customers have the same cause: silence during
the only window when the buyer is paying attention.

### 🔄 Why the review ask comes LAST
The obvious build asks for a review immediately. That costs you twice:

1. The buyer **has not used it yet**, so the review is thin and
   unconvincing.
2. The ask arrives **before any value was delivered**, so it reads as
   extraction.

This gives first — a help nudge, then a usage tip — and asks only after
the buyer has had time to get something out of it.

### 🛟 The step that protects your rating
Before asking for a **public** review, it asks privately:
**"did this work for you?"**

· Happy → review link
· Not happy → replies to **you**, not to a review page

A sequence that routes dissatisfaction into a private reply is worth far
more than one that simply harvests ratings — and it is more honest.

### ⏳ The upsell waits for the refund window
Mentioning another product before the refund window closes invites the
buyer to reconsider **both** purchases at once.

`upsellAfterDays` should be **longer** than your refund period. Set
`enableUpsell: false` to skip it entirely — the sequence works fine
without it.

nodes.name: 🎉 Order completed
nodes.notes: POST {orderId, email, name, productName}. Chain from A1-01 after delivery.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: upsellAfterDays must exceed your refund window. usageTip should be genuinely useful — filler here undoes the whole sequence.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 📝 Enrol the buyer
nodes.notes: Honours unsubscribes permanently, including for future orders.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config (sequence side)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Mirror of the main Config. Change one, change both.

nodes.name: ⏭️ Find who is due a message
nodes.notes: One stage per run maximum. The upsell stage only exists when enabled.

nodes.name: ✍️ Compose for this stage
nodes.notes: Four short messages. The check-in asks privately before asking publicly.

nodes.name: 📧 Send it
nodes.notes: Attach SMTP. Batched upstream to protect sending reputation.

nodes.name: 📊 Sequence summary
nodes.notes: Optional. Wire to a Sheet if you want a record.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.

nodes.name: 📒 Sequence log
nodes.notes: Track which stage people reach. A drop-off at one stage means that message needs rewriting.
